name: Claude Assistant
description: My own AI chat assistant on the Claude API, with streaming replies and a local server that keeps the API key off the browser.
highlights: Streaming responses with stop, Markdown and code blocks
Locked-down server: validation, CSP, no key exposure, 17 tests

name: Space Shooter
description: A neon canvas arcade shooter with enemy waves, power-ups, combos and a boss fight every five waves.
highlights: Fixed-timestep game loop, particles and screen shake
Synthesized sound effects, touch controls

name: Markdown Notes
description: A notes app with live Markdown preview, tags, search and pinned notes, stored in the browser's IndexedDB.
highlights: Every preview sanitized with DOMPurify against XSS
Tags, full-text search, import and export

name: Kanban Board
description: A Trello-style board with drag-and-drop cards, labels, due dates, checklists and multiple boards.
highlights: Drag and drop with mouse, touch and keyboard
JSON import with strict validation, undo

name: Typing Speed Test
description: Measure your words per minute and accuracy on common words or real code, with a live chart of every test.
highlights: Live character highlighting and WPM chart
Code-typing mode, personal bests and history

name: Budget Tracker
description: Track income and expenses with category budgets, hand-built charts and spreadsheet-safe CSV export.
highlights: Colorblind-safe SVG charts with tooltips
Exact cent math, CSV formula-injection protection

name: Uptime Monitor
description: Checks a list of websites, tracks response times and outages, and builds a status page like the big services have.
highlights: Live terminal view with sparklines
Self-contained HTML status report, 44 tests

name: syshealth
description: A terminal dashboard for CPU, memory, disks, network and top processes, with warnings when something runs hot.
highlights: Live watch mode, JSON output for scripts
Privacy switch masks IPs and MACs, 31 tests

name: Phishing Link Analyzer
description: Paste a suspicious link and see its red flags explained, with a risk score and the real destination exposed.
highlights: Catches look-alike domains, punycode and the @ trick
Runs 100% in the browser, never opens the link

name: Breach Checker
description: Rates password strength and checks Have I Been Pwned without ever sending the password anywhere.
highlights: k-anonymity: only 5 characters of a hash leave the browser
Crack-time estimates with zxcvbn

name: Cipher Playground
description: Encrypt, decode, hash and crack: Caesar, Vigenère, XOR, Base64 and SHA-256, each explained step by step.
highlights: Brute-force and frequency-analysis cracking
Code-breaking challenges

name: fim
description: A file integrity monitor that fingerprints every file with SHA-256 and reports exactly what changed.
highlights: Spots tampered files, dropped web shells and defacements
Live watch mode, JSON output, 31 tests

name: Weather
description: Search any city for current conditions and a 5-day forecast, with a sky that changes with the weather.
highlights: Live data from the Open-Meteo REST API
°C/°F toggle, geolocation, recent searches

name: passgen
description: A secure password and passphrase generator for the command line, with zero dependencies.
highlights: Cryptographically secure randomness
Entropy-based strength meter, 19 tests

name: Pomodoro Timer
description: A focus timer with an animated progress ring, automatic break cycle and a generated chime.
highlights: Drift-free timing in background tabs
Web Audio chime, keyboard shortcuts

name: To-Do
description: A clean task manager with priorities, filters, inline editing and dark mode.
highlights: Smart sorting by status and priority
Saved locally, safe from HTML injection

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The classic game with a two-player mode and an AI opponent that cannot be beaten.
highlights: Minimax algorithm for a perfect AI
Per-mode scores, animations
